statement: In a multicentre registry of processed nerve allograft repairs across body sites, most repairs reported meaningful sensory or motor recovery, including in gaps longer than conduits are used for.

context.model: peripheral nerve gaps repaired with processed allograft

measurement.effect: meaningful recovery in the majority of reported repairs

replication.note: An industry-sponsored registry, not a randomised comparison against autograft; reporting is voluntary.

drift: 'Allografts equal autografts' — the registry has no randomised control arm and cannot support an equivalence claim.
limitations: selection and reporting bias inherent to a voluntary registry

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
